![Hebrew Words • 7ESL](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10131400-2762-0139-0000-15c4cb127a4c:4)
Basic Hebrew words include essential everyday terms and common greetings used in the language.[[1]](https://www.teachmehebrew.com/500-basic-hebrew-words.html)[[2]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/4305107/jewish/13-Basic-Hebrew-Words-to-Know-and-Use-All-the-Time.htm)

### Essential Everyday Words & Greetings

- **Shalom** (שלום) — Peace, hello, or goodbye
- **Todah** (תודה) — Thank you
- **Ken / Lo** (כן / לא) — Yes / No
- **Mayim** (מים) — Water
- **Kafeh** (קפה) — Coffee
- **Bayit** (בית) — House
- **Kesef** (כסף) — Money
- **Ahavah** (אהבה) — Love[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)[[2]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/4305107/jewish/13-Basic-Hebrew-Words-to-Know-and-Use-All-the-Time.htm)[[3]](https://www.teachmehebrew.com/500-basic-hebrew-words.html)

### Core Pronouns & Question Words

- **Ani** (אני) — I
- **Ata / At** (אתה / את) — You (masculine / feminine)
- **Mah** (מה) — What
- **Mi** (מי) — Who
- **Eifoh** (איפה) — Where[[1]](https://www.hebrewpod101.com/blog/2021/09/23/hebrew-beginner-words/)[[2]](https://doitinhebrew.com/)

You can explore comprehensive lists and beginner guides through [Teach Me Hebrew](https://www.teachmehebrew.com/500-basic-hebrew-words.html) or review foundational vocabulary via [Chabad.org](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/4305107/jewish/13-Basic-Hebrew-Words-to-Know-and-Use-All-the-Time.htm).[[1]](https://www.teachmehebrew.com/500-basic-hebrew-words.html)[[2]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/4305107/jewish/13-Basic-Hebrew-Words-to-Know-and-Use-All-the-Time.htm)Would you like to focus on **conversational Modern Hebrew phrases**, **Hebrew alphabet (Aleph-Bet) letters** , or **religious/biblical terms**?
